nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable capping total token supply; read in mint and calcStartingIndex, written by setMaxTokenSupply.
Public bool gate that controls whether mint is allowed; toggled by flipSaleState and read in mint.
ERC721 reference to the external Pixel Planets contract; used by mint for ownership checks and burn transfers, and reassigned by setPlanetContract.
Public uint256 provably-fair starting index; written by calcStartingIndex (blockhash derived) and read as a guard.
Public uint256 recording the block used for the starting index derivation; written by reserveTokens and emergencySetStartingIndexBlock, read by calcStartingIndex.
Private string base URI for token metadata; written by setBaseURI and returned by _baseURI.
Public mint function: checks planets.ownerOf(tokenId)==msg.sender, saleIsActive and supply cap, then burns the planet via external transferFrom and mints a galaxy to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that drains the contract balance to msg.sender using payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance).
onlyOwner function that loops num times calling _safeMint(msg.sender, supply+i) and lazily sets startingIndexBlock.
onlyOwner function that inverts saleIsActive.
onlyOwner function assigning MAX_SUPPLY to an arbitrary caller-supplied value.
onlyOwner function deriving startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) and block.number/blockhash, with arithmetic on MAX_SUPPLY.
onlyOwner fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block.number.
onlyOwner function writing the base URI into _baseURIExtended.
onlyOwner function replacing the trusted planets ERC721 reference used by mint.
View function assembling metadata URI from _baseURI, per-token URI and tokenId.toString().
Internal view override returning _baseURIExtended; consumed by tokenURI.
Caller-controlled address used for planet ownership checks in mint and as the destination of funds in withdraw.
External call planets.transferFrom(burner, 0x...dEaD, tokenId) executed inside mint before the galaxy mint completes, handing control to an attacker-controlled token contract.
Value transfer payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) in withdraw, sending the entire contract balance to the caller.
User-supplied tokenId of the planet to be burned in mint.
Number of tokens the owner requests to reserve in reserveTokens.
New supply cap supplied to setMaxTokenSupply.
Token id queried in tokenURI.
New base URI string supplied to setBaseURI.
Replacement ERC721 address supplied to setPlanetContract.
Local balance snapshot of address(this).balance inside withdraw.
Local supply = totalSupply() snapshot inside reserveTokens.
Local burner = planets.ownerOf(tokenId) inside mint, used as the from-address of the burn transfer.

edges.reason: The mint tokenId parameter flows into the ownership check and minting logic.
Attacker-supplied tokenId is forwarded to the external planets.transferFrom burn call.
mint performs an external call to the planets contract before completing its own state changes (state update after external interaction).
The external planets.transferFrom call can re-enter mint through a malicious callback implementation before the galaxy is minted.
msg.sender is used as the authorization condition (planets.ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender) for minting.
withdraw sends the whole balance to msg.sender, so the caller identity determines the fund recipient.
withdraw reaches the value-transfer operation that sends ETH to the caller.
The local balance variable is computed inside withdraw and is passed to the value transfer.
saleIsActive gates execution of mint via require(saleIsActive).
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the supply check in mint.
The planets contract reference is read by mint for ownerOf and transferFrom.
flipSaleState writes the new value of saleIsActive.
setMaxTokenSupply writes the MAX_SUPPLY state variable.
setBaseURI writes the _baseURIExtended state variable.
setPlanetContract reassigns the planets ERC721 reference.
startingIndex is read as the zero-guard inside calcStartingIndex.
startingIndexBlock is consumed by calcStartingIndex for the blockhash derivation.
MAX_SUPPLY is used as the modulo divisor when deriving startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes the current block.number into startingIndexBlock.
reserveTokens lazily sets startingIndexBlock when it is still zero.
The num parameter controls the reservation loop length in reserveTokens.
The local supply value drives the token ids minted in the reserveTokens loop.
The maxSupply parameter is assigned to MAX_SUPPLY in setMaxTokenSupply.
The tokenId parameter is used in the existence check and string conversion in tokenURI.
tokenURI calls the internal _baseURI function.
_baseURI returns the _baseURIExtended state variable.
The baseURI_ parameter is stored by setBaseURI.
The address_ parameter is cast to ERC721 and stored by setPlanetContract.
The local burner address is passed as the from-argument of the external burn transfer in mint.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId parameter only exists as input to the mint function and should collapse into its core function.
The num parameter only bounds the minting loop of reserveTokens.
The maxSupply parameter is a direct input assigned inside setMaxTokenSupply.
The tokenId parameter is only used to build the URI inside tokenURI.
The baseURI_ parameter is a direct input stored by setBaseURI.
The address_ parameter is a direct input stored by setPlanetContract.
The balance local exists only inside withdraw and feeds the ether transfer.
The supply local exists only inside reserveTokens as the minting offset.
The burner local is derived in mint and passed directly as the from-address of the external burn call.
